name: Refact.ai
architecture: Moteur d'agent Rust (refact-agent/engine) : crates refact-* (core/chat-api/agentic/caps/context/history), tools en tool_*.rs, scratchpads + vecdb + knowledge_graph + memories frontmatter, subchat/background agents, LSP + git worktrees, privacy blocklist, plugins IDE vscode/intellij.

functionalities.name: Moteur agent complet en Rust (refact-agent/engine) : 16 crates + src module
functionalities.what: Un moteur d'agent en Rust : crates refact-core/chat-api/agentic/caps/context/history et un src/ : scratchpads, tools, providers, vecdb, knowledge_graph, lsp, git, worktrees.
functionalities.how: refact-agent/engine/ (Cargo workspace, crates/ contient refact-agentic, refact-ast, refact-chat-api, refact-core...) + engine/src/lib.rs. Omega : transposition directe au workspace omega de 16 crates ; decoupage crates homologue.

functionalities.name: Catalogue tool_* par schema : lifecycle/steer/diff/ask/background agents
functionalities.what: Un catalogue de tools par fichiers tool_*.rs : activate_skill, agent_lifecycle/steer/diff/pulse, buddy (draft/issue), ast_definition, background_agents, ask_questions...
functionalities.how: engine/src/tools/ (tool_agent_lifecycle.rs, tool_agent_steer.rs, tool_background_agents.rs, tool_ask_questions.rs...) + mod.rs (registre). Omega : ToolSurfaceIndex couvert.

functionalities.name: Scratchpads : session de contexte structuree par template + postprocessing
functionalities.what: Une scratchpad = une session de contexte structree : template par tache, multimodalite, postprocessing de la reponse.
functionalities.how: engine/src/scratchpads/ (mod.rs, multimodality.rs, scratchpad_utils.rs) + scratchpad_abstract.rs + postprocessing/. Omega : ContextEngine (template + postprocess).

functionalities.name: vecdb : index d'embeddings local + indexing incremental
functionalities.what: Vector DB local du workspace : embeddings de snippets re-indexes incrementalement, config yaml, token counting.
functionalities.how: engine/src/vecdb/ + indexing_utils.rs. Omega : omega-context (recherche semantique locale).

functionalities.name: Memories en frontmatter (faits + prefs) avec dedupe/normalisation tags
functionalities.what: Systeme de memoires persistantes : MemoRecord en markdown + frontmatter KnowledgeFrontmatter, dedupe des preferences, normalisation des tags (max_tags).
functionalities.how: engine/src/memories.rs : MemoRecord (:39), create_frontmatter (:133), normalize_memory_tags (:261), normalize_preference_text_for_dedupe (:767). Omega : FileMemoryStore ; retenu : normalisation/dedupe des tags.

functionalities.name: Knowledge graph de concepts de code relie aux memories
functionalities.what: Un KG des concepts du depot (kg_structs) alimente les memories via KnowledgeFrontmatter.
functionalities.how: engine/src/knowledge_graph/ + knowledge_index.rs + knowledge/. Omega : structure Graphify-like ; garder le meme futur port.

functionalities.name: Sous-agents : subchat + background agents + phases
functionalities.what: Les sous-agents tournent en sessions subchat separees, et tool_background_agents les relance en async ; subagent_phases structure les phases.
functionalities.how: engine/src/subchat.rs + tools/tool_background_agents.rs + tools/subagent_phases.rs. Omega : LocalSubagentRunner couvert.

functionalities.name: Integration LSP + git worktrees par agent
functionalities.what: Le moteur parle LSP au workspace et isole chaque agent dans un worktree git.

functionalities.name: Privacy : blocklist de fichiers sensibles, traitement local vs cloud
functionalities.what: Filtrage du contexte : files_blocklist (fichiers jamais envoyes), privacy.rs oriente local/cmloud par regle.
functionalities.how: engine/src/privacy.rs + engine/src/files_blocklist.rs. Omega : ExecPolicy (blocklist deja couverte).

functionalities.name: Stats telemetry agregee, visible en dashboard self-hosted
functionalities.what: Module stats des usages (runs, tokens) expose via http.rs.
